title: AI Sticker Search
shortDescription: Find the right sticker by meaning, in English, Hindi or Hinglish. Private.
fullDescription:
AI Sticker Search finds the perfect sticker among the ones already on your phone. Type what you want to say, like "so done with work", "kya bakwas hai" or "happy birthday", and it finds stickers that mean it, not just ones with matching words.

• Search by meaning in English, Hindi and Hinglish
• Search by look: every sticker is searchable minutes after setup
• Finds animated stickers too, and plays them like your chat app does
• One tap sends a sticker in WhatsApp, through WhatsApp's official sticker-pack feature
• Suggest stickers: share a chat screenshot and get fitting replies
• Related stickers: story sequences, look-alikes and shared topics
• Make your own sticker packs from a search
• Fix any description; your edits always win

Setup takes a minute: pick WhatsApp's sticker folder, and the app downloads its free search models (about 500 MB, on Wi-Fi). No account, no sign-in.

Want even smarter search? AI can describe every sticker (who's in it, what it says, the mood, when to send it). Do it free on your own PC in a few hours with the included script, or on the phone while it charges (that takes several nights for thousands of stickers, and the optional Gemma model needs a free Hugging Face account).

Private by design: the AI runs on your phone. Your stickers, chats and descriptions never leave it. The internet is used only to download the AI models. No ads, no tracking, no account. Open source.

AI Sticker Search is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp LLC or Meta Platforms, Inc.
